Magenta.js MusicVAE, for the coming-soon page's melodies (public/soon-music.js).

  music_vae.js        @magenta/music 1.23.1, es6/music_vae.js       Apache License 2.0, Google
  tf.min.js           @tensorflow/tfjs 2.8.6, dist/tf.min.js        Apache License 2.0, Google
  mel_2bar_small/     the mel_2bar_small checkpoint, from
                      storage.googleapis.com/magentadata/js/checkpoints/music_vae/
                      Apache License 2.0, Google (Magenta). The weight shards are
                      renamed .bin (and weights_manifest.json with them) so the
                      coming-soon gate passes them as assets.

https://github.com/magenta/magenta-js  https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
